name: Flowery Zaahen
creator: shrimpback
description:
It was one hell of a project with a LOT of work put into it, but also a ton of fun to make!! With the new set of tools we have now I think I will probably be posting more often (which is not to say REGULARLY but yk, more than biyearly xd)

With that said, I hope you enjoy this one! A lot of the cool stuff you see would not be nearly as good without the people that made it possible, so big shoutout to everyone that made this possible!

## - CREDITS -

## ShrimpBack (that's me!!)
Visual Effects: Edited most of the textures to have a pixel-art look to better the UTDR feel of the skin
Sound Effects: Replaced all sounds in the kit for UTDR sound effects (some made by combining multiple of them)
Voice Over: Edited all voice lines to be Flowery Voice Clips from Deltarune (jaboner)
Model work: Edited some parts of the models used and then weighted it to Zaahen's skeleton
Other stuff: some more work arround all these areas, with the help and/or assets from other creators

## dazashu
Gave me a LOT of help and advise regarding materials/meshes and the new tools for modding he helped to develop
